title: Wso2am: Information disclosure via SetWatches reconnect replay in Apache ZooKeeper due to missing ACL check…
description: An information disclosure vulnerability exists in the wso2am package due to a missing ACL check in Apache ZooKeeper's SetWatches reconnect replay mechanism. This flaw allows unauthorized network attackers to gain access to sensitive information without requiring privileges or user interaction. The issue affects versions prior to 4.4.0-r1 and 4.5.0-r4 and has been assigned a high severity with a CVSS score of 7.5. Fixed versions 4.4.0-r1 and 4.5.0-r4 are available.
